Stick with a great company and you’ll be rewarded [Yay]. Eli Lilly took just 2 years to shake up the global pharmaceutical rankings, jumping over the top ten companies straight to #1.  In 2025, prescription drug sales reached $60.777 billion, and the revenue from just two products—diabetes and weight loss—accounts for about 60% of Lilly’s prescription sales. On the flip side of this huge success is the massive treatment market fueled by modern people’s subhealth issues~
